name: Full map world overview owner acceptance

steps._note: NOT RUN. User opens native Map tab. Guard stays on; no automatic game launch/teleport/unlock. User scrolls out beyond the old 2km-wide limit; Shift+wheel retains native fast zoom behavior, gamepad zoom must reach same bound.

Check known road/POI terrain aligns with native player, waypoint and Purge markers. Pan positive/negative, return to detail zoom, place a waypoint at a known road intersection; check cursor/world position both ways. Test Purge filters, static overlays and world edges. A fresh overview frame loads known records progressively; allow it to settle before judging missing data.

User closes/reopens, loads another world, and explores new ground to verify record refresh and no old-world image leaks. Inspect minimap unchanged. Screenshots and error checks alone do not establish coordinate or gameplay acceptance.
